title: How to Export from Bangladesh: 7-Step Roadmap #Shorts
hook: keyword question 'How to export from Bangladesh?' + 'Seven steps, fast' with a 1→7 counter in a green dial
visual: 3D port at golden hour (push cam r170 h52) for the hook; 7-dot step tracker carried through every scene; steps 1-3 stacked white cards (trade licence art, e-TIN/BIN tiles, bank) on e_sky; 3D docs desk (Trade Licence/e-TIN/BIN/Chamber/ERC papers) behind cards 4-5; steps 6-7 buyer+PO+LC card and AD bank→EXP stamp→C&F truck→ship on e_gold; kit CTA en.
thumb: card / pal by --n 5 (purple-pink) / 'How to *export*|from Bangladesh' + 7 STEPS burst / hero 3D port golden orbit
script: How to export from Bangladesh? Seven steps, fast.
One, trade licence. Two, e-TIN and BIN. Three, a bank account.
Four, chamber membership. Five, your ERC export licence.
Six, win a buyer order or LC. Seven, the bank issues the EXP, a C&F agent ships.
Step six is easier on Exportain: let buyers find you.
lessons: Voice was already made by an earlier run (reused, no re-voice). 300 chars EN -> 24.5 s after tighten 1.08, final 27.6 s with cover. A persistent step tracker reads well for list topics. Docs world papers still fill the top half — keep cards in the bottom band. Port hero in orbit r120 gives a dense container yard for the thumbnail.
